A fill of a record a generator writes is refused with every reason, and nothing changes
The Reader opens a journey and reads its proof: its steps, how many are proved, and its journey test
They read each journey's proof under the measure of an outcome it serves
They follow the journey's steps in order to the use cases they carry out
They read a gap for each journey without a test, a main path or an outcome, and for each step that carries out nothing yet
They name what provides a record decided outside the product, in place of any provider it had
Coverage counts the provided record as accounted for
The Owner names the records they mean to change
They read the change's reach: each record it would touch by stage, with the path of links that reaches it
They read the files and tests it would touch, each test with its state, and the purposes it could break
They drop a record from the change and read what it no longer touches
Before it changes anything, an Agent reads the same reach
The Agent writes the test under the record it proves, with its level and state
A test says its size when it is not small, and marks itself smoke or external
The Agent names the file that runs an automated test
A manual test gives the reason it is manual, and its procedure in given, when and then
A test not automated yet may name the file it will live in; until the file exists that is a warning
A test with an unknown state or level, an automated test with no file, or a manual reason on a test that is not manual is refused
The Owner reads the test data set whole, with the tests that start from it, before changing it
The Owner adds a test data set under its domain, with the file that builds it
The Owner changes a data set's preparation and reset
The Owner removes a data set no test starts from
The Owner moves a test data set to the domain whose tests start from it
The Owner reads the pattern whole, with its rules and slots, before changing it
The Owner adds a pattern with its settings
The Owner adds each of its rules, and a pattern rule test per following domain
The Owner changes a rule's statement
The Owner reads the use case whole, with its requirements, flow and tests, before changing it
The Owner adds a use case with its actors and requirements, in groups where a long list needs them
The Owner adds its one flow, its ID the use case's and FL
The Owner adds the flow's steps in order on their paths, each with what it fulfills and invokes, and the interface it is a variant of when only one does it
The Owner adds the use case tests and the flow test, its acceptance test
The Owner removes a flow with its steps and test
The Owner adds a step fulfilling another use case's requirement, or a second flow, and is refused with every reason
The Owner moves a use case, with everything in it, under another capability of its domain or of another
The Owner moves a UC requirement, with its tests, to the use case whose goal it serves
